children: Oxford Industries reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 results with consolidated net sales of $394.4 million and GAAP diluted earnings per share of $3.25, which included a $2.07 per-share tariff refund benefit. On an adjusted basis (excluding tariff refunds and other items), diluted EPS was $1.34. The company noted a small year-over-year sales decline, stronger gross margins driven by tariff refunds and assortment/pricing changes, and ongoing actions to address softness at certain brands.
Net sales: $394.4 million in Q2 FY2026, down from $403.1 million in Q2 FY2025 (−2.2%).
Gross profit: $291.1 million in Q2 FY2026; reported gross margin 73.8% (Q2 FY2025: 61.4%).
Operating income (GAAP): $68.8 million (17.4% of net sales) for Q2 FY2026; adjusted operating income $29.3 million (7.4%).
Net earnings: $49.0 million for Q2 FY2026; diluted net earnings per share (GAAP) $3.25 and adjusted diluted EPS $1.34.
Balance sheet / liquidity: cash and cash equivalents $9.02 million; borrowings outstanding $73.2 million at quarter end; cash provided by operations of $97.3 million in the first half of FY2026.
Brand performance: Tommy Bahama delivered a low-single-digit comparable sales gain with net sales of $230.9 million in the quarter, showing positive momentum relative to the portfolio.
Other brands: Lilly Pulitzer sales declined and was noted as soft due to product and marketing challenges; Johnny Was and Emerging Brands also reported year-over-year sales declines.

Channel mix and shifts: Full-price DTC sales were $289 million (down 1%); e-commerce held steady at $150 million; wholesale was down 14% driven by lower off-price sales; food & beverage sales increased ~11% driven by new locations opened in FY2025.

Operational investments and moves: Continued openings of brick-and-mortar and food & beverage locations and completion/transition activity for the new Lyons, Georgia distribution center (related costs impacted SG&A).

Strategic actions: Management has increased promotional activity planned at Lilly Pulitzer, initiated an enterprise-wide review to identify opportunities to enhance long-term earnings power, and implemented merchandising, sourcing and pricing adjustments.
